The '''''War Pig''''' was a [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The cruiser was going to rendezvous with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] at [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. But was destroyed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in a [[Missile Boat]].
